youtube.baslik: Is there a sound amplifier inside your ear? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: Thanks to a motor protein called prestin, outer hair cells can rapidly shorten and lengthen. This motion boosts basilar membrane vibration for soft sounds; this mechanism, the cochlear amplifier, provides a gain of about 40 to 50 dB.
